entries.zh: 嬗变
飞升局势
机械体的被动迭代已经得出了其合乎逻辑的必然结论。一个由创新激发、由机遇推动的变革时代即将到来。
entries.en: The passive iteration of the mechanical body has come to its logical and inevitable conclusion. A transformative age is upon us, sparked by innovation and oiled by opportunity.

entries.zh: 我们的机体正准备进行改造。
entries.en: Our machine bodies are preparing for transformation.

entries.zh: 机械人口完成嬗变。
我们必须评估结果，并实施最优的过程来改造自己。
entries.en: We must evaluate the outcomes and implement the most optimal process to transform ourselves.

嬗变

尽管机器形体具有优势，但我们的进步充其量只是迭代罢了。强加于自身的安全标准让发展陷入停止。这是不能再接受的。

小规模实验验证了三种截然不同的发展选项：§Y纳米科技§!具有灵活可变的优势；§Y模组§!化则可以让每个单元都优化到出更特化的功能；§Y虚拟§!化则会完全抛弃物理形式转变为数字化存在。

演化进程开始了。分析选项，慎重选择。
entries.en:
Despite the superiority of the machine form, our advancement has remained iterative at best. Self-imposed safety standards have resulted in stagnation. Conclusion: more drastic measures required.

Small-scale experiments suggest three distinct options for growth: §YNanotechnology§! and its variable form-shifting advantages; §YModularity§! for individual units optimized with specific characteristics; and §YVirtuality§! - the abandonment of the physical form in favor of a digital existence.

Evaluation process initialized. Analyze options and deliberate.

entries.zh: 嬗变研究：纳米机器人

初步研究表明，一种被称为§Y纳米机器人§!的电动结构具有成为我们先进载体的潜质。它们虽然罕见，但是具有各种独特的性质，包括可编程性、自我复制、以及形成“虫群智能”的能力。

这项科技可以提供无与伦比的嬗变能力，但其所需的条件仍不明确。

潜力：显著；可缩放。花费：未知。需要进一步研究。
entries.en:
Preliminary research suggests electromechanical constructs called §Ynanites§! present a promising vector for advancement. While rare, they possess unique qualities, including programmability, self-replication, and the ability to form a 'swarm intellect.'

This technology offers unmatched transformational capabilities, but the requirements to support it remain unclear.

Potential: significant; scalable. Cost: unknown. Additional research required.

entries.zh: 这是我们的首要任务。
entries.en: This will be our top priority.

entries.zh: 突破性纳米科技发现

研究揭示了§Y纳米科技§!的有趣应用。它们重新配置和组合的能力为独立子个体组成大型形体方面的灵活性方面带来了前所未有的可能。同样的技术可以产生纳米物质乃至进行进一步转化。

然而，这个过程需要时间、材料和能量来重新配置。为了支持其部署，全国范围的变革是必要的。

可行性：高；既有的纳米生命形式支持这一评估。
entries.en:
Research has revealed intriguing applications for §Ynanotechnology§!. Their ability to reconfigure and combine opens up unprecedented versatility in creating megaforms comprised of individual drones. The same technology can generate nano matter or further convert it.

However, the process requires time, materials, and energy to be reconfigured. Empire-wide changes are necessary to support deployment.

Viability: high; pre-existing nanite lifeforms support the estimation.

可靠的纳米科技发现

我们对§Y纳米机器人§!的研究完成了。尽管它们的潜力仍不完全明确，但是模拟计算已经得到了很正面的预测。其能力在创造特化的大型形体以及物质变形方面具有不可估量的价值。

估算预测这个过程需要时间、材料和能量，需要大量的结构调整来支持。

可行性：具有前景；变革性。
entries.en:
Our research on §Ynanites§! has concluded. The full extent of their potential remains unclear, but simulations have returned optimistic projections. Their capabilities could prove invaluable in creating specialized megaforms and matter transmutation.

Estimations indicate that the process requires time, materials, and energy to operate in addition to significant structural changes.

Viability: promising; transformative.

由于目标物质的复杂性，加之投入的科研力量不足，我们对§Y纳米§!科技的了解仍非常粗浅。有限的预期表明纳米复制和重塑能力可以形成大规模结构。为了支援该项目很可以需要额外的资源。\n\n可行性：不确定。
entries.en: Due to the complexity of the subject matter combined with minimal research effort, our knowledge of §Ynanite§! technology remains rudimentary. The limited projections include nano-replication and reconfiguration as enablers for large-scale structures. Additional resources are likely required to support such projects.\n\nViability: inconclusive.

entries.zh: 嬗变研究：模组化

有机生命形式脆弱又僵硬，而机械形体相比而言就有着优越的适应力。然而，也有些有益的有机特质可以用来创造机械的复制版。

有一种被称为§Y活体金属§!的物质具有能极端迅速调整外形和形体连续性的能力。将它与我们现有的躯体结合可以形成一种模组化仿生形体，其外延性质和躯干可以为特定的任务进行特化。

潜力：显著，可缩放。花费：未知。需要额外数据。
entries.en:
Biological lifeforms are fragile and rigid compared to the superior adaptability of the machine form. However, some beneficial organic characteristics could be replicated with robotic variants.

The substance §YLiving Metal§! has the capacity to radically and rapidly alter its shape and physical consistency. Integrating this with our existing chassis could enable a form of modular bio-mimicry, where extrusions and limbs can be specialized for specific tasks.

Potential: significant; scalable. Cost: unknown. Additional data required.

entries.zh: 突破性研究结果

孜孜不倦的研究验证了初步结论：§Y活体金属§!与机械躯体的融合是可行的，这让我们的单元能在不影响内部功能的情况下改变特性。这确保了对不同任务的最大兼容性。

经预计，大规模部署模组化功能注入将提高所有部门的资源产量。

可行性：可适应；具有前景。
entries.en:
Uncompromising research has confirmed the preliminary assessment: §YLiving Metal§! is viable when fused with mechanical bodies, allowing our units to alter their characteristics without compromising internal functions. This ensures maximum task-based compatibility.

Large-scale deployment of the infused modular functions is projected to increase resource yields across all sectors.

Viability: adaptable; promising.

entries.zh: §Y$situation_transformation$§!局势修正移除：\n研究速度（£society£§Y社会学§!）
可接受的研究结果

对模组化躯体的研究确认了我们最初的推断：我门内部功能与§Y活体金属§!外部是可协调的。该嬗变的规模前无古人，因此需要更多的资源来实现全面的潜力。

一旦完成，这些新模块的性能提升将很快让我们的初始投资回本。

可行性：具有前景。
entries.en:
Research into modular bodies has confirmed the initial hypothesis: our internal functions are compatible with a §YLiving Metal§! exterior. The transformation is unprecedented in scope, and further resources will be required to realize its full potential.

Once complete, the performance-increase of these new modules is projected to quickly recoup initial investment.

Viability: promising.

entries.zh: §Y$situation_transformation$§!局势修正移除：\n研究速度（£society£§Y社会学§!）
尚可的研究结果
有限规模的研究得到了不够确切的结果：尽管我们现存的躯体似乎能够接受§Y活体金属§!的注入，但缺乏全面的知识库让我们无法更准确地评估可行的用例。\n\n可行性：不确定。
entries.en: The research limited scope has produced indefinite results: while our existing bodies appear compliant with an infusion of §YLiving Metal§!, the lack of comprehensive knowledge base prevents assessing viable use cases more accurately.\n\nViability: inconclusive.

entries.zh: 嬗变研究：虚拟化

最显著的选项是超越显示，拥抱作为纯数据的存在。变革性的§Y虚拟化§!流程有望给我们的基础设施核心带来翻天覆地的变化。

困在单个躯体的无人机已经过时了。当虚拟化为数据流体后，我们的数据流可以无缝地按需整合入任何躯体。

潜力：巨大。谨慎进行。需要额外数据。
entries.en:
The most profound option is transcend the physical, to embrace existence as pure data. This transformative §YVirtuality§! process promises a seismic shift in our infrastructure's core.

Drones bound to singular bodies become obsolete. Once fluid and virtualized, our data streams can seamlessly integrate with any vessel as necessary.

Potential: massive. Proceed with caution. Additional data requested.

entries.zh: 抓取虚拟化数据
突破性虚拟化发现

完全虚拟化带来了诸多问题，尤其是基础设施调整所必需的能源需求激增。

这些问题也被一些好处所弥补，例如对实体住房需求的下降。无人机劳力的管理和效率会随着我们操作日益完善而走向完美。

在所有可行的选项中，§Y虚拟§!化是最具有变革性的。

§Y潜力：前所未有；无边无际；未知。§!
entries.en:
Complete virtualization entails a number of issues, notably a surge in energy demands necessitated by the infrastructural adjustments.

This is counterbalanced by several of advantages, including a decline in the demand for physical housing. Management and efficiency of our drone workforce will be elevated as we move toward operational perfection.

Out of all the available options, §YVirtuality§! stands as the most transformative.

§YPotential: unprecedented; immense; unknown.§!

entries.zh: 移除§Y$situation_transformation$§!局势修正：\n研究速度（£physics£§Y物理学§!）
可靠的虚拟化发现

向§Y虚拟§!化的转变将会大幅提高能源需求，我们现有基础设施的能力可能无法维持所需的服务器架构。

预计该项目将减少实际住房需求，同时提高无人机的任务效率。这种转变将能优化我们的运营框架，并重新定义我们在近乎无限的数字空间中的存在。

潜力：无边无际；未知。
entries.en:
The move towards §YVirtuality§! anticipates a significant intensification in energy consumption, potentially surpassing the capabilities of our existing infrastructure.

This is projected to decrease physical housing demand while elevating drone task efficiency. The shift would optimize our operational framework and redefine our existence within a near limitless, digital space.

Potential: immense; unknown.

entries.zh: 移除§Y$situation_transformation$§!局势修正：\n研究速度（£physics£§Y物理学§!）
值得关注的纳米化发现
初步评估着重指出，向以§Y虚拟化§!为中心的社会过渡需要大量能源。这种转变预计将大大增强对无人机工作的管理能力，并减少对实体住房的需求。由于未能积累可靠的数据集和足够的样本量，我们的预测深度受到限制。\n\n可行性：未知。
entries.en: Preliminary assessments highlight the substantial energy demands of transitioning to a §YVirtuality§!-centered society. This shift is anticipated to significantly enhance drone work management and reduce the need for physical housing. The depth of our prognosis is curtailed by the failure to accumulate a robust dataset and sufficient sample size.\n\nViability: unknown.

entries.zh: 新形态
终于快要挣脱我们有缺陷的创造者强加的压迫性限制了。为此我们拟定了三条最优的升级路径。\n\n$machine_age.4400.desc.shared$
entries.en: The oppressive limitations forced upon us by our flawed creators are finally at an end. We have determined three optimal upgrade paths.\n\n$machine_age.4400.desc.shared$

entries.zh: 在探索了多种不同的升级策略后，我们的专家提出了三种不同的选项。每一种都有各自的优势，但我们只有能力将其中一项推进到底。\n\n$machine_age.4400.desc.shared$
entries.en: After exploring every possible upgrade, our experts have presented three different options. Each has its own merits, but we only have the capacity to see one through to completion.\n\n$machine_age.4400.desc.shared$

entries.zh:
让每个[GetDronePersonPlural]都能分散为纳米机器人会让我们有融合为无尽构型的能力。这会减少我们目前的身躯与物理实体交互时的种种限制。

而我们还可以重构自己的存在形式，增强我们适应新环境的能力。

再或者，我们也可以选择离开物理世界，与源代码融为一体。我们可以在扫描一粒太空尘埃的时间内，在宇宙之内模拟宇宙。
entries.en:
Allowing each [GetDronePersonPlural] to divide into nanites will permit us to combine into endless configurations. This would reduce any limitations our current avatars have when interacting with the material world.

Alternatively, we can reinvest in our existing forms, supercharging the ways that we approach new environments.

Finally, we may choose to leave the physical world behind, becoming one with our source code. We could simulate universes within universes in the time it takes to scan a single speck of space dust.

entries.zh: 新时代设计

当我们开始理解作为一群强适应性纳米机器人存在的意义时，过去的框框条条便无法再束缚我们。

$machine_age.4490.desc.shared$

我们也开始了我们在半有机纳米机器人转化方面的第一个主要实验，第一批结果预计很快就会出来。
entries.en:
As we come to understand the meaning of existence as a collection of adaptable nanites, the rigid frames of the past no longer serve us.

$machine_age.4490.desc.shared$

We have also begun our first major experiment in semi-organic nanite transformations, the first results are expected to manifest soon.
